title: SS28 Women's After Dusk
summary: Summer goes dark for evenings: aubergine, inky blue and murky green in sheer, satin and lace, with sharp flashes of colour.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Future Snoops' "After Dusk" brings deep aubergines, inky blues and murky greens to warm-weather dressing, as extreme heat moves socialising into the evening <sup>[1]</sup>. Lace, corsetry and dramatic silhouettes return in lighter materials <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Inky blue and magnetic violet with acid lemon or peach as the flash.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Slip and corset-line dresses in light fabrics.
- Sheer layers over dark bases.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Lace insets, fine straps, satin piping.

products: - Evening dresses, sheer tops, satin skirts.

sources.title: After Dusk: why Spring/Summer 2028 is going dark
sources.publisher: FashionUnited (Joanne Thomas, Director of Color, Future Snoops)
